items.exampleEn: I bought a portable speaker for camping trips.
items.exampleZh: 我買了一個露營時用的隨身喇叭。

items.exampleEn: You can personalize the phone case with your name.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在手機殼印上名字，打造專屬款式。
items.glossZh: 個人化、打造專屬；針對個人

items.exampleEn: The alarm malfunctioned and rang in the middle of the night.
items.exampleZh: 警報器故障，在半夜響了起來。

items.exampleEn: The board has a magnetic surface, so notes stick to it.
items.exampleZh: 這塊板子表面有磁性，所以便條會吸在上面。

items.exampleEn: Some synthetic diamonds look exactly like real ones.
items.exampleZh: 有些人造鑽石看起來跟真的一模一樣。

items.exampleEn: The trees act as a buffer between the road and the houses.
items.exampleZh: 這些樹在馬路和房子之間形成緩衝帶。

items.sentenceEn: If the machine malfunctions, press the red button.
items.sentenceZh: 如果機器故障，請按紅色按鈕。

items.audioEn: This portable battery fits easily in my pocket.
items.audioZh: 這個隨身電池可以輕鬆放進我的口袋。
options: It came free with a new phone
It charges three phones at once

items.sentenceEn: Many sports clothes are made of synthetic materials.
items.sentenceZh: 很多運動服都是用合成材料做的。

items.sentenceEn: A magnetic strip on the card stores your data.
items.sentenceZh: 卡片上的磁條會儲存你的資料。

items.stemEn: You can carry this ____ printer in a small bag.
items.stemZh: 這台隨身印表機可以放進小包包裡帶著走。

items.stemEn: The machine began to ____ after it got wet, so we called the repair shop.
items.stemZh: 機器淋濕後開始故障，所以我們打電話給維修店。

items.passageEn: Our school library recently tested a new self-service machine for borrowing books. Students can personalize the screen with their favorite colors, and the machine reads the magnetic strip in each book. During the first week, the machine malfunctioned twice when too many students used it at once. The company that made it then added more buffer memory so that it could handle more requests at the same time. The library also bought portable reading lamps made of light synthetic material. Most students now prefer using the machine to waiting in line at the front desk.
items.passageZh: 我們學校圖書館最近試用了一台新的自助借書機。學生可以用自己喜歡的顏色設定專屬畫面，機器會讀取每本書裡的磁條。第一週，太多學生同時使用時，機器故障了兩次。製造商隨後增加了更多緩衝記憶體，讓它能同時處理更多請求。圖書館還買了用輕巧合成材料製成的隨身閱讀燈。現在大多數學生都比較喜歡用機器，而不是在櫃台排隊。

questions.questionZh: 機器第一週為什麼故障？

options: 把機器搬到圖書館的另一個角落
增加了更多緩衝記憶體

items.promptZh: 這個網站可以讓你打造個人化的首頁。
referenceEn: This website lets you personalize your home page.
This website allows users to personalize their home pages.
rubricZh: personalize 是及物動詞，表示「個人化、打造專屬」（例如 personalize your page 等）
「讓你」可寫，例如 lets you、allows you to、you can 等

items.promptZh: 這位街頭藝人帶著一台可攜式電子琴到處表演。
referenceEn: The street performer carries a portable keyboard and plays everywhere.
The street musician takes a portable keyboard to perform in many places.
rubricZh: 「可攜式的」用 portable（例如 a portable keyboard 等）
「街頭藝人」可寫，例如 street performer、street musician 等
「到處表演」可寫，例如 plays everywhere、performs in many places 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正："a magnetic reader checks each book's code" 中譯為「條碼」，但磁性讀取器讀的是磁條而非條碼，技術敘述不合邏輯；建議改 "checks the magnetic strip in each book" 或改用 scanner。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 a reader checks the magnetic strip in each book，中譯「讀取器會檢查每本書裡的磁條」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："added a small buffer of memory" 搭配不自然，一般說 a (memory) buffer／more buffer memory。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 added more buffer memory，中譯與第 2 小題選項同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：作者疑慮回覆：synthetic 第一義「人造的」配人造鑽石例句可接受；本課其他兩處（運動服、閱讀燈材料）都是「合成的」，兩義皆常用，維持即可。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示 synthetic 維持「人造的」第一義

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：portable 造句參考答案與卡都是「帶去戶外的隨身喇叭」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案 1 改 I keep a small portable fan on my desk at work.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：personalize 是及物動詞，表示「個人化、打造專屬」（例如 personalize your page 等）／「讓你」可寫，例如 lets you、allows you to、you can 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（portable）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u34-l01-q15；目標字沿用 portable
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這位街頭藝人帶著一台可攜式電子琴到處表演。」、hintWords ["portable"]、referenceEn ["The street performer carries a portable keyboard and plays everywhere.","The street musician takes a portable keyboard to perform in many places."]、rubricZh ["「可攜式的」用 portable（例如 a portable keyboard 等）","「街頭藝人」可寫，例如 street performer、street musician 等","「到處表演」可寫，例如 plays everywhere、performs in many places 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 portable 造一個句子，說說一樣你常帶著走的電子產品。」、referenceEn ["I keep a small portable fan on my desk at work.","I use a small portable keyboard with my tablet."]）
